_doc: RATIFIED DIVERGENCES + JUDGMENT-CALL CORRECTIONS. Two lists. `divergences` = places where our corpus text DELIBERATELY differs from what the source page legibly prints, each ratified. `pending_review` = corrections made on Claude's own contextual judgment (with outside knowledge, as sanctioned) and awaiting Luneth's end-of-campaign sweep. WHY IT EXISTS: on 2026-08-02 a vision sweep re-flagged WAL-CLM-LETS-000349 (toxin/antitoxin) and WAL-CLM-IMMORT-000024 (1n/1nm) as defects. BOTH had already been ruled on and corrected in earlier sessions, and neither was written down -- so each was re-derived at the cost of a render, a 20x-40x read and an adversarial second read. Luneth: 'we already fixed this ... note it this time so this doesn't need to be re-derived.'
_the_rule: The page is EVIDENCE, not ground truth. Luneth 2026-08-02: 'the books are RIDDLED with errors ... we NEED outside information to correct it -- what we DON'T correct is true Wallach statements even if his statements disagree with outside norms, what we DO fix is when there's a clear typo or error.' So a genuine Wallach claim stands even against mainstream fact; a typesetter's or scanner's error gets fixed, using outside knowledge, and gets logged HERE for his review.
_internal_only: A verification-audit artifact. Read by tooling only. MUST NOT be surfaced to the user, rendered on any app surface, or folded into a derived artifact. Nothing under eden/tools/ is consumed by corpus_derive/build_embeds/build.mjs -- verified 2026-08-02 -- and that must stay true.
_standard: Each entry states what OUR text holds, what the PAGE prints, WHO decided, WHEN, and the EVIDENCE. An entry without a decider and a reason is not a ratified divergence -- it is an undisclosed change, which is the defect class this file prevents.

divergences.reason: A 1000x misprint carried identically by all four books. 400 mg of elemental silver daily causes argyria and silver toxicity; Youngevity's own colloidal-silver products deliver 13-40 MCG, corroborating mcg as intended. Corrected under the dose-misprint safety mandate: safety outranks byte-faithfulness for a dose a reader could act on. NEVER restore the printed 400 mg.
divergences.evidence: Recorded in memory dose-misprint-safety-mandate; all three ids re-measured 2026-08-02 and each still carries the corrected figure. WAL-CLM-EPIGEN-000064 was in the same 2026-07-21 sweep but its verbatim no longer contains the figure, so nothing there can regress.
divergences.proven_useful: 2026-08-02: a vision agent hit IMMORT-000027, checked this list, and returned DOCTRINE_OK instead of proposing a restore to 400 mg.

divergences.reason: The treatment is tetanus ANTItoxin (the neutralising antiserum). The page's 'toxin' is a book misprint that, left standing in a protocol a reader could act on, describes administering the poison. Luneth: 'We already fixed this, ours is correct, it's antitoxin.' The earlier fix was never logged, which is why this file exists.
divergences.evidence: Page read 2026-08-02 at 14x-20x (lets-play-doctor PDF p157 = printed p145): no hyphens, no parentheses, no 'anti' prefix -- the line literally begins 'fixed toxin,'. The divergence is real and deliberate, not an OCR artifact on either side.
divergences.do_not_confuse: The same claim carried a genuine OCR defect, FIXED 2026-08-02 and not a divergence: 'rv q6 h' -> 'IV q6 h'.

The SAME book prints 'cartilage at 5 gm t.i.d.' twice more -- WAL-CLM-LETS-000326 (joint pain, printed p139) and WAL-CLM-LETS-000435 (sprains, printed p169) -- and printed p139 also carries '5 gm flaxseed oil t.i.d.', so gm is this book's normal unit for bulk supplements. The carpal-tunnel entry's 'mg' is the book contradicting itself.
divergences.evidence: printed p139 read by eye 2026-08-02 (gm, confirmed); p169 corroborated by the PDF text layer agreeing with our gm; the p111 'mg' page-read twice at 22x by independent agents. NO SOURCE CHANGE WAS MADE -- our text was already correct.

divergences.page_prints: produced krypton fluoride (KrF4) as Pauling had predicted.
divergences.reason: The only well-characterized krypton fluoride is KrF2, so the printed subscript 4 is a compositor error and our KrF2 already holds the correction. Luneth ruled 2026-08-02, choosing this over the competing reading (that KrF4 is Wallach's own assertion, since a 1963 report of KrF4 did exist in the literature before it was shown to be misidentified KrF2). NEVER restore the printed KrF4.
divergences.evidence: Page read 2026-08-02 twice independently, immortality Screenshot (95) RIGHT half = printed p165. At the raw pixel level the subscript shows a diagonal stroke, a horizontal crossbar, and a vertical stem continuing BELOW the crossbar -- a topology present in neither a 2 nor a 3 in this face, both checked against templates elsewhere in the book. The page prints 4. The reader DECLINED to resolve it and escalated; the skeptic could not refute the glyph reading either. Our KrF2 is at eden/corpus/books/immortality.txt.
divergences.do_not_confuse: This is the opposite shape to the sibling KNO2/KNO3 case in IMMORT-000191, which WAS settled without a ruling: there the page contradicts its own words in the same clause ('potassium nitrate'/'saltpeter'), so the page is self-refuting. Here it is not.

batch_2026-08-02-wave1._control_result: Of the 30 control claims -- claims where BOTH independent OCR passes AGREED -- 4 still carried a defect (3 ours, 1 a book typo), i.e. 13%.
